acceptanceCriteria: A fixture with a tracked file containing a secret-shaped value proves query, context, context --expand and MCP outputs either omit or redact it with a disclosed exclusion.
If an unscreened path is found, it is fixed in the same change.
body: Filed 2026-09-27 from the owner-requested gap analysis of Corvint against competing context tools, current standards and a trial on a local clone of MeVille (TypeScript, about 4,600 tracked files). Only `internal/contextindex/history.go` in the context index imports internal/secretscreen. Packets carry summaries rather than bodies, but `--expand` and excerpt paths may emit file content. Agents leaking .env values is a reported failure mode for coding hosts (knostic.ai). Unverified: whether any packet or expansion path emits unscreened file content.
title: tests: no test proves that context expansion and packet output screen secret-bearing lines (unverified)
